[[Mesmer Deldrimor armor]] is the collective name used to refer to the stand alone armor pieces crafted for mesmers by [[Gobrech Stonefoot]] in [[Central Transfer Chamber]]. It is also sometimes referred to as Dwarven armor.

It is made up of the following pieces:
*[[Mesmer Elegant Long Coat|Elegant Long Coat]]
*[[Mesmer Studded Hose|Studded Hose]]
*[[Mesmer Silken Footwear|Silken Footwear]]

The total cost for all pieces would be 300{{cloth}}, 30{{silk}} and 30{{plat}}
